# Testing checklist

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-feature-docs.mjs from the data; edit the data, then run it again. -->

Go through each feature step by step, simple to complex. Stable features get a quick smoke pass; new (beta) and in-progress (dev) features get the full list. Home-control items follow the stages of the home-control plan. Mark each test Pass, Fail, Skip or Blocked on the Testing page (Settings → This app → Testing).

The same list is on the **Testing** page (Settings → This app → Testing, in the development version), with Pass / Fail / Skip / Blocked buttons, notes, progress per feature and **Promote to stable**. Its Markdown or CSV export feeds `scripts/promote-features.mjs` for the next release.

⚠ marks a step with heat, motion, power or real email sending: read it before you start.

## Schedule and calendar (Stable)

### schedule-01: See today and add an item by voice

1. Open the Dayspring screen.
2. Say "Dayspring, add a test block tomorrow at 3 p.m. for 30 minutes".
3. Open the Schedule (📅) and go to tomorrow.

**Expected:** The block is there at 3:00–3:30 p.m. and Dayspring said it added it.

- [ ] Pass  - [ ] Fail  - [ ] Skip  - [ ] Blocked  Notes: ____

### schedule-02: Move and resize in the week view

1. Open the Schedule, switch to Week.
2. Drag the test block to another day.
3. Drag its bottom edge to make it an hour long.

**Expected:** It moves and resizes, and stays that way after you reload the page.

- [ ] Pass  - [ ] Fail  - [ ] Skip  - [ ] Blocked  Notes: ____

### schedule-03: Remove the test block

1. Say "remove the test block" (or open it and click Delete).

**Expected:** It's gone from the schedule, and nothing else moved.

- [ ] Pass  - [ ] Fail  - [ ] Skip  - [ ] Blocked  Notes: ____


## Voice and talking (Stable)

1. On the printer's screen, write down its IP address, its Access Code (Settings → Network / WLAN) and its serial number (Settings → Device).
2. X1 Carbon, X1, X1E, P1S, P1P, A1, A1 mini: turn on LAN Only Mode, then Developer Mode on the same page (firmware from 2025 on ignores commands from other software without Developer Mode; status still shows).
